sources.population: IMF World Economic Outlook LP via DataMapper, Oct 2026 vintage (millions converted to persons; World Bank unavailable)
sources.fx_rate: No data available from World Bank or ECB

fx_definition: Annual average units of local currency per 1 US dollar (calendar-year basis, Dec 31 year-end convention)
news_note: 2-3 major geopolitical events per year, editorial selection, one-line summaries
sport_note: One notable sporting event per year involving the country, editorial selection

geopolitical_news.headline: Biya marks 24 years in power
geopolitical_news.summary: The president's long rule faces little challenge as the opposition remains divided.

geopolitical_news.headline: Bakassi handover begins
geopolitical_news.summary: Nigeria starts transferring the disputed peninsula under the 2002 ICJ ruling.

sport.headline: Cameroon miss 2006 World Cup
sport.summary: A last-day qualifying defeat to Egypt denies the Indomitable Lions a fifth straight World Cup.

geopolitical_news.headline: Legislative elections favor ruling party
geopolitical_news.summary: Biya's RDPC wins July's parliamentary vote amid opposition fraud claims.

geopolitical_news.headline: Corruption crackdown hits elites
geopolitical_news.summary: Operation Sparrowhawk jails ministers in an anti-graft campaign.

sport.headline: Cameroon qualify for 2008 AFCON
sport.summary: The Indomitable Lions book a place at the Ghana tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Constitution amended to scrap term limits
geopolitical_news.summary: April's change lets Biya seek re-election indefinitely, sparking protests.

geopolitical_news.headline: Food riots shake cities
geopolitical_news.summary: February protests over prices leave dozens dead in Douala and Yaounde.

sport.headline: Cameroon reach AFCON final
sport.summary: The Indomitable Lions lose 1-0 to Egypt in the 2008 final in Accra.

geopolitical_news.headline: Biya reshuffles government
geopolitical_news.summary: Cabinet changes aim to refresh the regime ahead of the 2011 election.

geopolitical_news.headline: Piracy hits Gulf of Guinea
geopolitical_news.summary: Attacks on shipping off Cameroon's coast draw international concern.

sport.headline: Cameroon qualify for 2010 World Cup
sport.summary: The Indomitable Lions reach South Africa 2010, their sixth World Cup.

geopolitical_news.headline: Biya celebrates 50 years of independence
geopolitical_news.summary: Lavish May ceremonies mark the anniversary amid opposition boycotts.

geopolitical_news.headline: Journalist dies in custody
geopolitical_news.summary: The death of editor Bibi Ngota sparks outcry over press freedom.

sport.headline: Cameroon exit World Cup winless
sport.summary: Three defeats at South Africa 2010, including to Denmark and the Netherlands, end a poor campaign.

geopolitical_news.headline: Biya re-elected for sixth term
geopolitical_news.summary: The 78-year-old wins October's vote; observers cite irregularities.

geopolitical_news.headline: Opposition cries foul
geopolitical_news.summary: Rivals reject the result as the ruling party machine rolls on.

sport.headline: Cameroon miss 2012 AFCON
sport.summary: Shock qualifying failure keeps the Indomitable Lions out of the 2012 tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Plane crash kills officials
geopolitical_news.summary: A May crash claims senior government figures.

geopolitical_news.headline: Boko Haram threat grows
geopolitical_news.summary: The Nigerian jihadist group begins cross-border raids in the Far North.

sport.headline: Cameroon miss 2013 AFCON
sport.summary: A second straight qualifying failure, losing a playoff to Cape Verde.

geopolitical_news.headline: French priest kidnapped
geopolitical_news.summary: Boko Haram abducts Father Georges Vandenbeusch in the Far North.

geopolitical_news.headline: Senate elections held
geopolitical_news.summary: Cameroon's first senate is chosen under the ruling party's dominance.

sport.headline: Cameroon qualify for 2014 World Cup
sport.summary: A playoff win over Tunisia takes the Indomitable Lions to Brazil 2014.

geopolitical_news.headline: Boko Haram war escalates
geopolitical_news.summary: Suicide bombings and raids devastate the Far North; Cameroon joins the regional task force.

geopolitical_news.headline: Biya declares war on Boko Haram
geopolitical_news.summary: The president vows to crush the insurgents after mass abductions.

sport.headline: Cameroon exit World Cup in disarray
sport.summary: Three defeats and a dressing-room brawl mar a miserable Brazil 2014 campaign.

geopolitical_news.headline: Suicide bombings hit the Far North
geopolitical_news.summary: Boko Haram attacks kill dozens in border towns throughout the year.

geopolitical_news.headline: Cameroon hosts regional summit
geopolitical_news.summary: Yaounde coordinates the multinational fight against the jihadists.

sport.headline: Cameroon reach 2015 AFCON
sport.summary: The Indomitable Lions return to the tournament but exit at the group stage.

geopolitical_news.headline: Anglophone crisis erupts
geopolitical_news.summary: October strikes by lawyers and teachers in English-speaking regions turn into a separatist uprising.

geopolitical_news.headline: Train disaster kills dozens
geopolitical_news.summary: An October derailment near Eseka becomes one of Cameroon's worst rail accidents.

sport.headline: Cameroon qualify for 2017 AFCON
sport.summary: The Indomitable Lions book a place at the Gabon tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Anglophone crackdown intensifies
geopolitical_news.summary: Leaders are arrested, the internet is cut in English regions, and protests turn violent.

geopolitical_news.headline: Biya's long absences questioned
geopolitical_news.summary: The aging president's extended stays abroad fuel succession speculation.

sport.headline: Cameroon win Africa Cup of Nations
sport.summary: A 2-1 final victory over Egypt in Libreville delivers Cameroon's fifth AFCON title.

geopolitical_news.headline: Biya wins seventh term
geopolitical_news.summary: The 85-year-old takes October's vote as the Anglophone conflict rages.

geopolitical_news.headline: Anglophone violence worsens
geopolitical_news.summary: Separatist ambushes and army reprisals displace hundreds of thousands.

sport.headline: Cameroon stripped of 2019 AFCON hosting
sport.summary: CAF moves the tournament to Egypt over Cameroon's slow preparations.

geopolitical_news.headline: National dialogue on Anglophone crisis
geopolitical_news.summary: September talks grant special status to English regions but exclude separatist leaders.

geopolitical_news.headline: Opposition leader Kamto jailed
geopolitical_news.summary: Maurice Kamto is imprisoned after disputing the 2018 election.

sport.headline: Cameroon exit AFCON in round of 16
sport.summary: A 3-2 defeat to Nigeria ends the holders' 2019 campaign in Egypt.

geopolitical_news.headline: Ngarbuh massacre shocks nation
geopolitical_news.summary: Soldiers kill civilians including children in a February Anglophone village raid.

geopolitical_news.headline: Regional elections held
geopolitical_news.summary: December's vote implements decentralization promised in the national dialogue.

sport.headline: Football suspended by pandemic
sport.summary: Cameroon's leagues halt for months amid COVID-19.

geopolitical_news.headline: Anglophone conflict grinds on
geopolitical_news.summary: Separatist attacks and military operations continue with no political settlement.

geopolitical_news.headline: Biya's health rumors swirl
geopolitical_news.summary: The 88-year-old president's rare appearances fuel speculation.

sport.headline: Cameroon prepare to host AFCON
sport.summary: Stadiums are completed for the delayed 2021 tournament kicking off in January 2022.

geopolitical_news.headline: Cameroon hosts Africa Cup of Nations
geopolitical_news.summary: The January-February tournament proceeds amid separatist threats in host cities.

geopolitical_news.headline: Stadium crush kills eight
geopolitical_news.summary: A deadly stampede at Yaounde's Olembe stadium mars the tournament.

sport.headline: Cameroon reach World Cup, beat Brazil
sport.summary: The Indomitable Lions stun Brazil 1-0 at Qatar 2022 but exit at the group stage.

geopolitical_news.headline: Biya marks 90th birthday in power
geopolitical_news.summary: The world's oldest head of state shows no sign of stepping aside.

geopolitical_news.headline: Anglophone crisis festers
geopolitical_news.summary: Kidnappings and school boycotts continue in the English-speaking regions.

sport.headline: Cameroon qualify for 2023 AFCON
sport.summary: The Indomitable Lions book a place at the Ivory Coast tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: Biya's absences spark succession talk
geopolitical_news.summary: Weeks out of public view in 2024 fuel rumors about the 91-year-old's health.

geopolitical_news.headline: Opposition unites for 2025 vote
geopolitical_news.summary: Rivals begin coordinating to challenge Biya's expected re-election bid.

sport.headline: Cameroon exit AFCON in round of 16
sport.summary: A 2-0 defeat to Nigeria ends Cameroon's 2023 campaign.

geopolitical_news.headline: Biya wins eighth term at 92
geopolitical_news.summary: October's election extends the president's 43-year rule amid fraud claims.

geopolitical_news.headline: Post-election protests crushed
geopolitical_news.summary: Security forces suppress demonstrations disputing the result.

sport.headline: Cameroon qualify for 2025 AFCON
sport.summary: The Indomitable Lions reach the Morocco tournament.
